opening.argument: The evidence shows an active solicitation for an investment-based cryptocurrency system built around assurances of protected and substantial earnings. The speaker states that “the money cannot get cut or blocked” and promises “100% money being distributed within the time limit,” presenting the promoted arrangement as offering assured returns. The speaker also expressly links income to investment, saying it is something “which you can earn by investing as much as you want.” This is paired with recruitment and a direct invitation to participate: “You can build your team We train you for this,” followed by, “If you are interested, please call me Call me at 0741.” Taken together, these statements promote investing, team-building, and contacting the speaker for further participation, rather than offering detached commentary or investigation.
